item.title: How My Shopping Assistant Grew, One Step at a Time
item.description: After I started using OpenClaw, I kept tinkering with different ways to use it—except when work got busy or I was too tired to bother. Recently I’ve been thinking about sharing some of my hands-on experiences from time to time. This time it’s about a shopping assistant that started as a simple shopping list and gradually grew into something that could search Xiaohongshu, compare prices, and add items to my cart.
